OUTSIDE CATERING

Your place.
Your people.
A shared table.

Hosting away from the resort? Joy Ripples offers outside catering. Discuss your occasion with the team and request a menu and quotation tailored to your requirements. Suggested starting points include a shared buffet, a tea-and-snacks service or a plated meal; ask the resort which arrangements they can provide.
